target: Meme Lab public playground professional redesign

contract.purpose: Turn one pasted comment or situation into a useful meme immediately without making the operating surface feel juvenile.
contract.canonicalPurpose: Meme Lab turns one pasted comment or situation into a useful meme immediately.
contract.audience: The owner first, with a public playground for lightweight feedback.
contract.job: Describe one complete situation, inspect the best meme and four honest alternatives, and record whether the recommendation fits.
contract.thesis: A restrained reference workspace replaces doodles, candy-colored tiles, and oversized marketing composition while keeping the task immediate.
contract.system: Navy navigation, white working surfaces, cobalt actions, quiet semantic states, compact typography, modest corners, and uniform media fields cover all three public pages.
contract.signature: The ranked result behaves like a reference record: real meme media, fit label, perspective, catalogue signals, and four compact alternatives.
contract.risk: Professional restraint can drift toward generic software, so meme media remains visually dominant and perspective-aware ranking stays explicit.

projectCheck.command: npm test && npm run check && git diff --check && pnpm exec wrangler deploy --dry-run

ownerFeedback.note: Owner asked to avoid overengineering and approved the recommended simple Reference Desk direction.
